title: PLC/SCADA Engineer
summary: PLC/SCADA engineers program the controllers (PLCs) and operator screens (SCADA and HMI) that run machines, factories, plants and utilities. They sit in industrial automation teams at system integrators, equipment makers and plants, and spend time both at a desk and on site during commissioning.
dailyDuties: Write and change PLC logic for machines and process lines
Build HMI and SCADA screens, alarms and trends
Test control panels and logic before dispatch
Connect drives, meters and field devices over industrial networks
Troubleshoot breakdowns with plant maintenance teams

skills.expectation: Write and change PLC logic in ladder, structured text or function blocks
Work with Siemens, Rockwell or Schneider PLCs and field I/O
Build SCADA and HMI screens, alarms and trends
Connect field devices over Modbus and RS-485
Set up IP addressing and Ethernet links between PLCs, HMIs and servers
Find and fix faults during testing, commissioning and plant breakdowns
Work with customers and operators on site and train them on the system
Store and report plant data from historians or MES databases
Apply basic security to plant networks
Script data exports and small tools
Maintain I/O lists and test sheets

certifications.why: Siemens PLCs are widely used in Indian plants, and this is SITRAIN's programmer certification.
OT security under IEC 62443 is increasingly expected of control engineers.
